caveats:
This product contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2026), processed by ESA and analyzed by the Earth Observatory of Singapore - Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS).

These are preliminary maps derived from satellite radar and should be used as guidance only. Coloured pixels may include false positives, and their absence does not mean an absence of damage or flooding.
methodology_other: Change detection on synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite images acquired before and after the event. Damage Proxy Maps show significant changes in radar coherence and amplitude; Flood Proxy Maps show areas that changed to standing water. Maps are preliminary and checked against news reports and ground-level imagery where available.

# Philippines Flood Luzon: Flood Proxy Maps, Aug 2026

The **Earth Observatory of Singapore – Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS)** produced these flood proxy maps for Philippines Flood Luzon (Aug 2026) from synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite images. Each map is a separate ZIP below with its GeoTIFF, a KMZ for Google Earth, the PNG figures and a text file describing how it was made and how to read it.

## Maps in this dataset

- **EOS-RS Flood Proxy Map: Luzon, Philippines, Floods , 02 September 2026, v0.9**
- **EOS-RS Flood Proxy Map: Luzon, Philippines, Floods , 14 August 2026, v0.9**

**More map details and files:** <https://sf.earthobservatory.sg/event/EOSRS_2026_011_PHL_FL_202608_Luzon>

**Legal Disclaimer:** <https://products.earthobservatory.sg/#/faq/>

organization.description: The Earth Observatory of Singapore - Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS) is a research lab at Nanyang Technological University (NTU), Singapore. It uses satellite remote sensing, mainly synthetic aperture radar (SAR), to map natural hazards and disasters. The lab produces Damage Proxy Maps (DPMs) and Flood Proxy Maps (FPMs) showing where damage or flooding has likely occurred. Its work focuses on Southeast Asia and the wider Asia-Pacific, and it also responds to major disasters worldwide.

resources.description:
EOS-RS Flood Proxy Map: Luzon, Philippines, Floods , 02 September 2026, v0.9

ZIP containing: GeoTIFF, KMZ, PNG, TXT.

The Earth Observatory of Singapore - Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS) created this preliminary Flood Proxy Map (FPM) depicting areas that are likely flooded in Luzon, Philippines due to heavy rainfall from four tropical depressions. This map was derived from synthetic aperture radar (SAR) images acquired by the Copernicus Sentinel-1 satellite operated by the European Space Agency (ESA) before (08 March 2026 to 25 July 2026) and during (30 August 2026) the event.

EOS-RS Flood Proxy Map: Luzon, Philippines, Floods , 14 August 2026, v0.9

ZIP containing: GeoTIFF, KMZ, PNG, TXT.

The Earth Observatory of Singapore - Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS) created this preliminary Flood Proxy Map (FPM) depicting areas that are likely flooded in Luzon, Philippines after the heavy rainfall caused by the enhanced monsoon Habagat and Tropical Depression Luis and Maymay. This map was derived from synthetic aperture radar (SAR) images acquired by the Copernicus Sentinel-1 satellite operated by the European Space Agency (ESA) before (20 Mar 2026 to 31 July 2026) and during (12 August 2026) the event.
